entities.text: Meera Singh vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioners seeks permission to withdraw the quashing application with regard to petitioner No 5 who died during pendency of the present case.

Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.36537 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 2
3 This quashing application is dismissed in so far as petitioner No 5 Gyan Ranjan Singh is concerned.
4 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State.

5 Issue notice to Opposite Party No 2 both under Speed Post as well as under ordinary course, for which requisites etc must be filed on or before 10.11.2023, failing which the present quashing application shall stand rejected without further reference to the Bench.

7 In the meantime, further proceedings before the Judicial Magistrate, 01st Class, Patna in connection with Mahila PS Case No 2 of 2021 registered for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506/34 of IPC read with Sections  of Dowry Prohibition Act, shall remain stayed as it has been submitted that petitioner No 1 is mother-in-law and petitioners No 2, 3 and 4 are sisters-in-law (Nanad) of Opposite Party No 2 and petitioner No 5 is the husband of petitioner No 2,
who died during pendency of the present case.

It is next submitted that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife, the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36537 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 manner with general and omnibus allegation.

It is next submitted that even husband was accused in the instant FIR, but he was not able to bear the false allegations alleged against him and his family members leading to his death.
(Satyavrat Verma, J) M.E.H./-
